title: KISA 한국인 졸업생 커리어 패널
desc: KISA는 학부생과 현재 기술 산업에서 일하는 한국 졸업생을 연결하기 위한 대면 네트워킹 이벤트를 주최하게 되어 기쁩니다. 아마존의 인턴십 및 협력 프로그램에 대해 더 알아보고, 아마존 소프트웨어 개발 엔지니어의 이력서 피드백 기회를 제공합니다.

caption.text:
📚Korean Alumni SWE Career Panel📚

KISA is excited to host an in-person networking event designed to connect undergraduate students with a Korean alumnus currently working in the tech industry!

Join us to learn more about Amazon’s internship and co-op programs, and get the opportunity to have your resume reviewed by an Amazon Software Development Engineer.

🗓️ Date: Thursday, March 19th
 ⏰ Time: 6:45 PM – 8:45 PM 
 📍 Location: NUB 1528

The event is open to anyone interested in software engineering, AI, and tech careers, and will be held primarily in English.

‼️RSVP highly encouraged‼️

RSVP can be found in @kisa_michigan bio

[Sessions]

⏱️ 6:45 – 7:45 PM | Main Session
-Behavioral interviews
-Current industry trends in Software Engineering & AI
-Resume strategies for tech roles
-Recruiting and hiring process overview
-Internship & co-op opportunities in tech

⏱️ 8:00 – 8:45 PM | Resume Workshop
-Individual / small-group resume feedback
-Career advice and networking with the panel

[Panel Information]

📌Jaehyun Shim: Software Development Engineer @ Amazon 
- Class of ’23 / BS in Computer Science, Minor in Mathematics
-Class of ’24 / MSE in Computer Science
